dashboard.label: Overview
dashboard.hint: Your workflow and finances at a glance, calculated straight from your data.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.hint: One row per customer job, from request to bookkeeping. The Position column shows how far each job has got; the Next step button opens the stage that needs work.

request.label: Requests
request.hint: Record what the customer needs. Its status moves along with the workflow stages.

offer.label: Offers
offer.hint: AI drafts the scope and price, then business rules check it before it is saved.

assign.label: Assignments
assign.hint: Schedule who works on each approved offer, and when.

complete.label: Completion
complete.hint: Close finished assignments so they are ready to book.

bookkeeping.label: Bookkeeping
bookkeeping.hint: Record income and costs for each job. The balance is kept running.

report.label: Reports
report.hint: Figures for the selected period from the ledger, plus an AI explanation.

invoice.label: Invoices
invoice.hint: Create invoices from finished jobs, send them by email or WhatsApp, then mark them paid. The income goes into Bookkeeping automatically.

vas.label: Add-on services
vas.hint: Two ways to grow revenue: sell add-on services on existing jobs, and stop cost leaks. Here you find VAS opportunities, manage the catalog, and plan them with five AI teams.

zeroWaste.label: Zero waste
zeroWaste.hint: Measure idle time, travel, materials, rework, and water and chemicals in Rupiah. Log findings, act on them, and see how close you are to zero loss.

radar.label: Opportunity radar
radar.hint: Opportunities from your own transactions: recurring services coming due, customers who went quiet, stalled offers, and busy seasons.

leads.label: Lead finder
leads.hint: Pick a point and a radius, then choose a business type. AI scores the fit and helps draft an offer. No messages are sent automatically.

socialMedia.label: Social media
socialMedia.hint: Connect Facebook and Instagram, write content with AI, schedule posts, and request ads or collaborations.

advisor.label: AI advisor
advisor.hint: An AI advisor that reads your business numbers. Conversations are stored on this device.

aiAssistant.label: AI Superpowers
aiAssistant.hint: An AI assistant with calculator, business data and rupiah formatting tools. Conversations are kept in session memory.

plan.label: Plan & quota
plan.hint: Your plan, this month's remaining AI quota, AI balance, and voucher redemption.

support.label: Help
support.sub: Tickets to the Satu Alur team
support.hint: Send questions or complaints to the Satu Alur team and follow their replies here.

drawer.title: Settings
drawer.note: Changes are saved automatically in this browser.
